description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 03 Oct - 31 Oct
Timing: 11.00 AM - 1.00 PM
Venue: Hazratganj & Gomti Nagar - Lucknow
Contact: Indrajeet (9196254114)

Greetings From ShiningStars ITPL!! 
 We are seeking customer-focused, proactive, and resilient Customer Care Representatives to join the fast-paced BPO team. In this role, you will be the front-line ambassador for clients brand, handling inbound customer inquiries across multiple channels. Your primary goal will be to deliver exceptional customer experiences, resolve inquiries on first contact, and uphold performance metrics. 
 Location: Hazratganj & Gomti Nagar Shifts: Male (24/7) & Female (Day Rotational) Interview Mode: Walk-in Age Limit: Max. 30 Salary (Full Time): 13k - 15k (Fresher) (Subject to Communication) and up to 22k In-hand (Subject to Communication & Experience) Schedule: 6 days working and 1 rotational week off 
 Openings are also available for Part Time. Requirement: Only Male can apply. Must have 2-Wheeler. Completely night shift Salary: 7k 
 Qualifications & Requirements Education: Any 12th pass can apply. Experience: Fresher and Experienced both are eligible. Communication Skills: Decent verbal and written English with strong active listening skills. Technical Proficiency: Basic computer navigation skills and typing speed (28 - 30+ WPM preferred). 
 Key Responsibilities Customer Interaction & Support: Answer inbound communications promptly and professionally to resolve account, product, or service inquiries. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting: Identify customer needs, research problems, and provide accurate step-by-step solutions or escalate complex issues to higher tier teams. Data Management & Documentation: Accurately log call details, customer feedback, and ticket updates into the CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk). Quality & Performance Compliance: Meet key operational performance metrics, including Average Handling Time (AHT), First Call Resolution (FCR), and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores. Product & Process Knowledge: Stay up-to-date with brand guidelines, campaign updates, product specifications, and process workflows. Escalation Handling: De-escalate challenging customer situations with composure and transfer complex tickets to Tier-2 support or specialized teams when appropriate. 
 NOTE: - SHINING STARS ITPL DO NOT CHARGE ANY FEES FROM THE CANDIDATES Applicants must not have any pre-determined leave requirement in this month or in the next 3 months. 
 Contact Details - Indrajeet 9196254114 (Call/WhatsApp) 
 Please share this job with your friends/colleagues/any job seeker, so that you can be a helping hand for someone who is/are looking for a job or job change. 
 For more job updates, you can join my WhatsApp group as well, link given: https://rb.gy/elrvxh
